key_insight: Quantum 3xplorer (Q3) demonstrates scientist-supervised, AI-agent development of a quantum simulation engine in weeks rather than years.
engineering_relevance: Its layered architecture and schema-validated inputs and outputs aim to simplify physics extensions, hardware adaptation, and integration into AI-driven materials workflows.
method: Domain scientists define physics and validation criteria; AI agents write, test, and optimize code.
Implement end-to-end plane-wave pseudopotential DFT with multiple formalisms, forces, stresses, and structural relaxation.
Separate abstract quantum concepts from numerical representations in an Apache 2.0 open-source framework.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports agreement with established reference implementations, faster single-core execution in representative benchmarks, and scaling across GPU-accelerated supercomputers, but provides no numerical metrics.
watch_item: Extensibility beyond plane-wave DFT is an architectural aim, not a validated capability demonstrated in the abstract.
paper_title: Quantum 3xplorer: AI-Native Engine for Next-Generation Quantum Materials Modeling
